claims.citation: The Sun (New York), 11 June 1866, p. 4, col. 4
New York Herald, 11 June 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Ship Mercury, Stetson, Havre May 2, with mdse and 421
passengers, to Boyd & Hincken. Had heavy westerly gales
up to the Banks, since then light winds and fogs. May 25,
lat 41 15, lon 45 06, spoke bark "Ernst Charles" (Fr), from
Aquin (St Domingo) for Havre, 69 days out, short of provi-
sions—supplied her. Had 8 deaths on the passage—all
infants.
